# NEW 2026-11-19 round 7 C8, Thessalonica and the revolt of Mustafa. Generated by gen_thessalonica.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ================================================================ monthly
# BYZ scope, monthly: the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py LINES, line 12 "ths") calls it until
# global oe_ths_all_done is set. The pool of the bet (.12 .13) runs in oe_ths_bet_monthly from the bet framework.
oe_ths_monthly = {
    oe_ths_upkeep = yes
    oe_ths_a_tick = yes
    oe_ths_b_tick = yes
    oe_ths_d_tick = yes
    oe_ths_close_check = yes
}

# BYZ scope. Clean-ups (design 3.10).
oe_ths_upkeep = {
    # The 1387 privileges belong to Ottoman rule only (B3's treaty may bring the city back).
    location:thessaloniki = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_ths_privileges NOT = { oe_ths_turkish = yes } } remove_location_modifier = oe_ths_privileges }
    }
    # The Treaty of Gallipoli frees the city from the harac of 1387 (not from a later one: oe_ths_harac_a marks 1387).
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ivr_treaty has_variable = oe_ths_harac_a }
        remove_variable = oe_ths_harac_a
        location:thessaloniki = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_ths_harac } remove_location_modifier = oe_ths_harac } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ths_harac_pay } remove_country_modifier = oe_ths_harac_pay }
    }
    # No city, no payment.
    if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ths_harac_pay NOT = { location:thessaloniki = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_ths_harac_pay
    }
    # A follow-up (.15, .17) that can no longer come.
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ths_followup oe_ths_tur_gone = yes } remove_variable = oe_ths_followup }
}

# ================================================================ A. The second court
oe_ths_a_tick = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ths_a_begun } NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ths_a_void } }
        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1395.1.1 } set_global_variable = oe_ths_a_void }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ths_a_can_begin = yes oe_ml_free = yes } random = { chance = oe_ths_a_chance oe_ths_a_begin = yes } }
    }
    # Safety net: .1 was never answered.
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ths_a_begun NOT = { has_variable = oe_ths_stage_a } NOT = { has_variable = oe_ths_a_wait } }
        oe_ths_a_end = { why = 9 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ths_stage_a ?= 1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ths_a_pending } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ths_m add = 1 }
        oe_ths_a_mods = yes
        if = { limit = { NOT = { location:thessaloniki = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } } oe_ths_a_end = { why = 8 } }
        else_if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_ths_prince ?= { is_alive = yes } } } oe_ths_a_finale = { why = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ths_tur_gone = yes } oe_ths_a_finale = { why = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ths_m >= 60 } oe_ths_a_finale = { why = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ths_m >= 8 oe_ths_reach = yes oe_ml_free = yes } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ths_stage_a ?= 2 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ths_a_pending } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ths_bm add = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ths_will add = -1 }
        if = { limit = { oe_ths_encircled = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_ths_will add = -1 } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ths_ven_galleys } change_variable = { name = oe_ths_will add = 1 } }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_ths_will min = 0 max = 100 }
        oe_ths_a_mods = yes
        oe_ths_blockade_mod = yes
        if = { limit = { NOT = { location:thessaloniki = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } } oe_ths_a_end = { why = 8 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ths_tur_gone = yes } oe_ths_a_finale = { why = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ths_will <= 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_ths_a_pending months = 3 } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.5 }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ths_bm >= 48 var:oe_ths_will >= 30 } oe_ths_a_finale = { why = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ths_bm >= 48 } set_variable = { name = oe_ths_a_pending months = 3 } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.5 }
        else = { if = { limit = { oe_ml_free = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ths_cd_a } OR = { oe_ths_ok_3 = yes oe_ths_ok_4 = yes } } random = { chance = 20 set_variable = { name = oe_ths_cd_a months = 4 } random_list = { 1 = { trigger = { oe_ths_ok_3 = yes } set_variable = oe_ths_done_3 oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.3 } 1 = { trigger = { oe_ths_ok_4 = yes } set_variable = oe_ths_done_4 oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.4 } } } } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Picks the prince (scope:oe_ths_p): B2's second son, else the emperor's eldest valid son.
oe_ths_pick_prince = {
    var:oe_vas_second ?= { if = { limit = { oe_ths_prince_valid = yes } save_scope_as = oe_ths_p } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_ths_p } }
        ruler ?= {
            ordered_child = {
                limit = { oe_ths_prince_valid = yes }
                order_by = age_in_days
                position = 0
                check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = oe_ths_p
            }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Part A begins: .1.
oe_ths_a_begin = {
    oe_ths_pick_prince = yes
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ths_p }
        set_global_variable = oe_ths_a_begun
        set_variable = { name = oe_ths_prince value = scope:oe_ths_p }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ths_a_wait months = 24 }
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.1
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .1 a / c: the second court (stage 1).
oe_ths_a_court = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ths_stage_a value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ths_m value = 0 }
    oe_ths_a_mods = yes
}
# BYZ scope. The court's modifiers, renewed every month (they lapse within two months if the line stops).
oe_ths_a_mods = {
    location:thessaloniki = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ths_second_court months = 2 mode = replace } }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ths_two_courts months = 2 mode = replace }
}
# BYZ scope. The blockade modifier, renewed every month while a blockade runs (parts A and D).
oe_ths_blockade_mod = {
    location:thessaloniki = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ths_blockaded months = 2 mode = replace } }
}
# BYZ scope. Resolve +n (0-100).
oe_ths_will_add = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ths_will }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ths_will add = $n$ }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_ths_will min = 0 max = 100 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The court ends with .6 (why: 1 held, 2 no threat came, 3 the prince is gone, 4 the Ottomans are gone).
oe_ths_a_finale = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ths_a_why value = $why$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ths_a_pending months = 3 } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.6
}
# BYZ scope. Part A ends without .6 (why: 7 recalled, 8 the city lost in war, 9 .1 never answered).
oe_ths_a_end = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ths_a_why value = $why$ }
    oe_ths_a_close = yes
}
# BYZ scope. Part A is over (oe_ths_a_why says how; 5 the city went to the Ottomans, 6 the city pays a harac).
oe_ths_a_close = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ths_stage_a value = 9 }
    set_global_variable = oe_ths_a_done
    location:thessaloniki = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_ths_second_court } remove_location_modifier = oe_ths_second_court }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_ths_blockaded } remove_location_modifier = oe_ths_blockaded }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ths_two_courts } remove_country_modifier = oe_ths_two_courts }
    remove_variable = oe_ths_m
    remove_variable = oe_ths_bm
    remove_variable = oe_ths_will
    remove_variable = oe_ths_a_pending
    remove_variable = oe_ths_a_wait
    remove_variable = oe_ths_cd_a
    remove_variable = oe_ths_ven_galleys
}
# BYZ scope. Hidden .92: the gates open in 1387 (.5 a). Encircled: the city goes to the Ottomans with privileges; else a
# harac (the city stays ours and pays every year).
oe_ths_1387 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ths_encircled = yes }
        location:thessaloniki = {
            change_location_owner = c:TUR
            add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ths_privileges years = 20 mode = replace }
            set_variable = oe_ths_ceded_1387
        }
        set_global_variable = oe_ths_fell_1387
        set_variable = { name = oe_ths_a_why value = 5 }
    }
    else = {
        location:thessaloniki = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ths_harac years = 15 mode = replace } }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ths_harac_pay years = 15 mode = replace }
        set_variable = oe_ths_harac_a
        set_global_variable = oe_ths_yoked
        set_variable = { name = oe_ths_a_why value = 6 }
    }
    oe_ths_appease = { amount = 20 }
    oe_ths_a_close = yes
}
# BYZ scope. The prince defies the sultan: B2's patience while the vassalage runs, else an Ottoman grudge (5 years).
oe_ths_defy = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_stage } oe_vas_add_patience = { amount = $amount$ } }
    else = {
        c:TUR ?= {
            if = { limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_ths_defiance target = c:BYZ } } remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_ths_defiance target = c:BYZ } }
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ths_defiance target = c:BYZ }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The opposite: B2's patience rises, or the grudge is dropped.
oe_ths_appease = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_stage } oe_vas_add_patience = { amount = $amount$ } }
    else = {
        c:TUR ?= {
            if = { limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_ths_defiance target = c:BYZ } } remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_ths_defiance target = c:BYZ } }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The theme of region 8 (Thessaloniki), if there is one: recent loyalty.
oe_ths_theme_loy = {
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 8 }
        oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = $amount$ }
    }
}

# ================================================================ B. The revolt of Mustafa
oe_ths_b_tick = {
    # The bet ended without its settlement (the framework closes it silently when the Ottomans are gone or Osmaris began).
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ths_mus_begun NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ths_mus_done } NOT = { var:oe_bet_round ?= 2 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ths_mus_out value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = oe_ths_mus_done
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ths_b_idle = yes }
        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1440.1.1 } oe_ths_mus_void_now = { why = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ths_hostage_ready = yes } oe_ths_take_hostage = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ths_refuge_ok = yes oe_ml_free = yes } random = { chance = oe_ths_refuge_chance oe_ths_refuge = yes } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_ths_in_custody = yes }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_ths_pretender ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:BYZ } } } oe_ths_mus_void_now = { why = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { current_date >= 1440.1.1 } oe_ths_mus_void_now = { why = 5 } }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ths_succession_due = yes oe_ml_free = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ths_b_pending } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ths_b_pending months = 6 }
            oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.11
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .10: the eldest valid Ottoman prince seeks refuge.
oe_ths_refuge = {
    dynasty:ottomans_dynasty ?= {
        ordered_character_in_dynasty = {
            limit = { oe_ths_refugee_valid = yes }
            order_by = age_in_days
            position = 0
            check_range_bounds = no
            save_scope_as = oe_ths_r
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ths_r }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ths_cand value = scope:oe_ths_r }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ths_b_pending months = 6 }
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.10
    }
}
# BYZ scope. B3's hostage has grown up: the prince in custody, no event and no payment (design 3.1).
oe_ths_take_hostage = {
    dynasty:ottomans_dynasty ?= { random_character_in_dynasty = { limit = { oe_ths_hostage_valid = yes } save_scope_as = oe_ths_r } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ths_r }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ths_pretender value = scope:oe_ths_r }
        set_variable = oe_ths_hostage_path
        c:TUR ?= { ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ths_su } }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ths_su } set_variable = { name = oe_ths_sultan value = scope:oe_ths_su } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Hidden .94 (.10 a): the refugee is taken in, kept on Lemnos, paid for.
oe_ths_custody_take = {
    var:oe_ths_cand ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_ths_r } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ths_r }
        scope:oe_ths_r = { if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } move_country = c:BYZ } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ths_pretender value = scope:oe_ths_r }
        c:TUR ?= { ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ths_su } }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ths_su } set_variable = { name = oe_ths_sultan value = scope:oe_ths_su } }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ths_custody years = -1 mode = replace }
        c:TUR ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ths_custody_op target = c:BYZ } }
    }
    else = { oe_ths_mus_void_now = { why = 4 } }
    remove_variable = oe_ths_cand
}
# BYZ scope. Part B is void (why: 1 handed back, 2 sent away, 3 no refugee by 1440, 4 the prince died or left,
# 5 the sultan outlived 1440).
oe_ths_mus_void_now = {
    set_global_variable = oe_ths_mus_void
    set_variable = { name = oe_ths_mus_why value = $why$ }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ths_custody } remove_country_modifier = oe_ths_custody }
    remove_variable = oe_ths_pretender
    remove_variable = oe_ths_cand
    remove_variable = oe_ths_sultan
    remove_variable = oe_ths_b_pending
}
# BYZ scope. Hidden .95 (.11 c): the prince is handed to the new sultan and imprisoned.
oe_ths_hand_over = {
    var:oe_ths_pretender ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { is_alive = yes }
            if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR NOT = { owner ?= c:TUR } } move_country = c:TUR }
            imprison_character_effect = { years = 10 }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ths_custody } remove_country_modifier = oe_ths_custody }
    c:TUR ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ths_handed_over_2 target = c:BYZ } }
    set_variable = oe_ths_handed
    set_variable = { name = oe_ths_mus_out value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = oe_ths_mus_done
}
# BYZ scope. Hidden .90 (.11 a): bet round 2. p1 the new sultan, p2 the prince (backed, commitment 1, +10 for
# the Thracians who join), who moves to the Ottoman state so that the framework can seat the prince on a win.
oe_ths_bet_begin = {
    c:TUR ?= { ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_bet_p1 } }
    var:oe_ths_pretender ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_bet_p2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_bet_p1 exists = scope:oe_bet_p2 NOT = { has_variable = oe_bet_round } }
        oe_bet_open = { round = 2 }
        oe_bet_set_back = { n = 2 }
        oe_bet_add_stake = { amount = 1 push = 5 }
        oe_bet_push = { n = 2 amount = 10 }
        scope:oe_bet_p2 = { if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= c:TUR } } move_country = c:TUR } }
        set_global_variable = oe_ths_mus_begun
        activate_situation = situation:oe_ths_mustafa
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = oe_ths_mus_begun
        set_variable = { name = oe_ths_mus_out value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = oe_ths_mus_done
    }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ths_custody } remove_country_modifier = oe_ths_custody }
}
# BYZ scope. Round-2 hook of the bet framework (gen_bet_framework.py ROUNDS), monthly while the bet runs:
# the sultan's base in Anatolia (+2), the forced settlement after 18 months, else the pool .12 .13.
oe_ths_bet_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { oe_bet_alive_1 = yes var:oe_bet_c1 ?= { is_ruler_of = c:TUR } } oe_bet_push = { n = 1 amount = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_bet_running = yes has_variable = oe_bet_m var:oe_bet_m >= 18 } oe_bet_resolve = yes }
    else = { if = { limit = { oe_ml_free = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ths_cd_b } OR = { oe_ths_ok_12 = yes oe_ths_ok_13 = yes } } random = { chance = 35 set_variable = { name = oe_ths_cd_b months = 2 } random_list = { 1 = { trigger = { oe_ths_ok_12 = yes } set_variable = oe_ths_done_12 oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.12 } 1 = { trigger = { oe_ths_ok_13 = yes } set_variable = oe_ths_done_13 oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.13 } } } } }
}
# BYZ scope. Hidden .96 (.12 a): the envoys ask for Gallipoli.
oe_ths_gallipoli_embassy = {
    random_list = {
        30 = {
            location:gallipoli = { if = { limit = { oe_ths_turkish = yes } change_location_owner = c:BYZ } }
            set_variable = oe_ths_gal_given
        }
        70 = {
            oe_bet_push = { n = 2 amount = -5 }
            set_variable = oe_ths_gal_refused
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .14 immediate: the outcome is kept in oe_ths_mus_out (the framework's own variables go when the bet closes):
# 1 backed the prince and won, 2 switched to the sultan and won, 3 backed the loser, 0 no winner or only watched.
# The sultan won: the prince is executed (design decision 5).
oe_ths_settle = {
    var:oe_bet_c1 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ths_k1 }
    var:oe_bet_c2 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ths_k2 }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ths_k1 } set_variable = { name = oe_ths_mus_c1 value = scope:oe_ths_k1 } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ths_k2 } set_variable = { name = oe_ths_mus_c2 value = scope:oe_ths_k2 } }
    var:oe_bet_wc ?= { save_scope_as = oe_ths_kw }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ths_kw } set_variable = { name = oe_ths_mus_w value = scope:oe_ths_kw } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_bet_out_won var:oe_bet_winner ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_ths_mus_out value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_bet_out_won var:oe_bet_winner ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_ths_mus_out value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_bet_out_lost has_variable = oe_bet_winner var:oe_bet_winner >= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_ths_mus_out value = 3 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_ths_mus_out value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_bet_winner ?= 1 exists = scope:oe_ths_k2 scope:oe_ths_k2 = { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:TUR } }
        kill_character = { target = scope:oe_ths_k2 reason = execution }
        set_variable = oe_ths_executed
    }
}
# BYZ scope. .14 a: the follow-up for the outcome, then the bet closes.
oe_ths_after_settle = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ths_mus_out ?= 1 } set_variable = oe_ths_followup trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ths.15 days = 30 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ths_mus_out ?= 2 }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 10 mutual = yes } }
        c:TUR ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ths_kept_faith target = c:BYZ } }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ths_mus_out ?= 3 } set_variable = oe_ths_followup trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ths.16 days = 30 } }
    oe_ths_mus_finish = yes
}
# BYZ scope. Part B's contest is over; the bet closes.
oe_ths_mus_finish = {
    set_global_variable = oe_ths_mus_done
    oe_bet_close = yes
}
# BYZ scope. .15 immediate: the grateful sultan. Gallipoli (60%, if not given yet), the tribute ends, a 15-year truce.
oe_ths_grateful = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ths_gal_given } location:gallipoli = { oe_ths_turkish = yes } }
        random_list = {
            60 = { location:gallipoli = { change_location_owner = c:BYZ } set_variable = oe_ths_gal_given }
            40 = { set_variable = oe_ths_reneged add_prestige = -5 }
        }
    }
    c:TUR = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } oe_ttb_peace_clear = yes } }
    oe_ttb_recount = yes
    if = { limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR } } add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 15 mutual = yes } }
    c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ths_mus_grateful target = c:BYZ } }
    remove_variable = oe_ths_followup
}
# BYZ scope. .16 b: hold the walls (the Theodosian Walls of Constantinople make it cheaper).
oe_ths_walls = {
    if = {
        limit = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ has_building = building_type:theodosian_walls } }
        add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
        add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -2 }
    }
    else = {
        add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
        add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -4 }
        location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ths_siege_scars years = 5 mode = replace } } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Hidden .93 (.17 a): the peace of 1424. Tribute again under a buying-peace agreement (oe_ttb); on harsh terms
# the towns recovered by B3's treaty outside region 8 go back. Like B3's own .10 a, the empire is no longer free of tribute.
oe_ths_1424_accept = {
    c:TUR = { save_scope_as = oe_ttb_t }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { c:TUR = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace } } } oe_ttb_peace_sign = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ths_mild } }
        every_owned_location = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_ivr_ceded NOT = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 8 } }
            change_location_owner = c:TUR
            remove_variable = oe_ivr_ceded
        }
    }
    remove_global_variable = oe_ivr_tribute_freed
    set_global_variable = oe_ths_1424
    remove_variable = oe_ths_followup
}
# BYZ scope. .17 b: the peace refused.
oe_ths_1424_refuse = {
    c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ths_1424_spurned target = c:BYZ } }
    if = { limit = { has_truce_with = c:TUR } remove_truce_with = c:TUR }
    c:TUR = { if = { limit = { has_truce_with = c:BYZ } remove_truce_with = c:BYZ } }
    set_global_variable = oe_ths_1424_refused
    remove_variable = oe_ths_followup
}

# ================================================================ D. The blockade
oe_ths_d_tick = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ths_d_begun } NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ths_d_void } }
        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1453.1.1 } oe_ths_d_void_now = { why = 11 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ths_d_hist = yes NOT = { location:thessaloniki = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } } oe_ths_d_void_now = { why = 12 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ths_d_can_begin = yes oe_ml_free = yes } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.20 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_ths_stage_d ?= 1 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ths_d_pending } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ths_bm add = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ths_will add = -1 }
        if = { limit = { oe_ths_encircled = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_ths_will add = -1 } }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_ths_will min = 0 max = 100 }
        oe_ths_blockade_mod = yes
        if = { limit = { NOT = { location:thessaloniki = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } } oe_ths_d_end = { why = 6 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ths_tur_gone = yes } oe_ths_d_end = { why = 7 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ths_will <= 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_ths_d_pending months = 3 } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.23 }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ths_bm >= 60 var:oe_ths_will >= 30 } set_variable = { name = oe_ths_d_pending months = 3 } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.23 }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_ths_ok_22 = yes oe_ml_free = yes } set_variable = oe_ths_done_22 set_variable = { name = oe_ths_d_pending months = 3 } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.22 }
        else = { if = { limit = { oe_ml_free = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ths_cd_d } OR = { oe_ths_ok_21 = yes } } random = { chance = 25 set_variable = { name = oe_ths_cd_d months = 3 } random_list = { 1 = { trigger = { oe_ths_ok_21 = yes } set_variable = oe_ths_done_21 oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.21 } } } } }
    }
    # The news of 1430: the Venetian city has fallen to the Ottomans.
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_ths_to_ven
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ths_fell_1430 }
            location:thessaloniki = { oe_ths_turkish = yes }
            oe_ml_free = yes
        }
        set_global_variable = oe_ths_fell_1430
        oe_ml_take_as = { line = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.24
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Part D is void (why: 11 no blockade by 1453, 12 the city was not ours when its time came).
oe_ths_d_void_now = {
    set_global_variable = oe_ths_d_void
    set_variable = { name = oe_ths_d_why value = $why$ }
}
# BYZ scope. .23 immediate: resolve spent -> the city falls (encircled) or pays a harac; else it held out.
oe_ths_d_outcome = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ths_will var:oe_ths_will <= 0 oe_ths_encircled = yes }
        location:thessaloniki = { change_location_owner = c:TUR }
        set_global_variable = oe_ths_fell_turk
        oe_ths_d_end = { why = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ths_will var:oe_ths_will <= 0 }
        location:thessaloniki = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ths_harac years = 15 mode = replace } }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ths_harac_pay years = 15 mode = replace }
        set_global_variable = oe_ths_d_harac
        oe_ths_d_end = { why = 3 }
    }
    else = {
        add_prestige = 10
        set_global_variable = oe_ths_d_held
        oe_ths_d_end = { why = 4 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Hidden .91 (.22 a): the city goes to Venice.
oe_ths_to_venice = {
    location:thessaloniki = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_ths_blockaded } remove_location_modifier = oe_ths_blockaded }
        change_location_owner = c:VEN
        set_variable = oe_ths_to_ven
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ths_ven_pledge years = 10 mode = replace }
    }
    c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ths_handover target = c:BYZ } }
    oe_itp_add_claims = { kd = -10 }   # D1 design 4.2: the city pays down the Venetian claims
    c:TUR ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_ths_ven_rival target = c:VEN } }
    set_global_variable = oe_ths_to_ven
    oe_ths_d_end = { why = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. Part D is over (why: 1 to Venice, 2 fell, 3 harac, 4 held, 5 bought off, 6 lost in war, 7 the Ottomans gone).
oe_ths_d_end = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_ths_stage_d value = 9 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ths_d_why value = $why$ }
    set_global_variable = oe_ths_d_done
    location:thessaloniki = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_ths_blockaded } remove_location_modifier = oe_ths_blockaded } }
    remove_variable = oe_ths_bm
    remove_variable = oe_ths_will
    remove_variable = oe_ths_d_pending
    remove_variable = oe_ths_cd_d
}

# ================================================================ the end of the line
# BYZ scope. All three parts are over or void, no follow-up is due, and the news of 1430 has come (or cannot come):
# global oe_ths_all_done, and the scheduler stops calling this line.
oe_ths_close_check = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = { has_global_variable = oe_ths_a_done has_global_variable = oe_ths_a_void }
            OR = { has_global_variable = oe_ths_mus_done has_global_variable = oe_ths_mus_void }
            OR = { has_global_variable = oe_ths_d_done has_global_variable = oe_ths_d_void }
            OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ths_followup } current_date >= 1460.1.1 }
            OR = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ths_to_ven } has_global_variable = oe_ths_fell_1430 current_date >= 1460.1.1 }
        }
        set_global_variable = oe_ths_all_done
    }
}

# ================================================================ interfaces
# BYZ scope. For C7 (1394): the city that pays a harac goes to the Ottomans with the privileges. Not called by this line.
oe_ths_yoke_annex = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR location:thessaloniki = { owner ?= c:BYZ has_location_modifier = oe_ths_harac } }
        location:thessaloniki = {
            remove_location_modifier = oe_ths_harac
            change_location_owner = c:TUR
            add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_ths_privileges years = 20 mode = replace }
            set_variable = oe_ths_ceded_1394
        }
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ths_harac_pay } remove_country_modifier = oe_ths_harac_pay }
        remove_variable = oe_ths_harac_a
        set_global_variable = oe_ths_annexed_1394
    }
}

# ================================================================ test page (DEV_LINES in gen_thessalonica.py; BYZ scope)
# thsa: pick the prince and send .1 at once (no start conditions).
oe_ths_test_court = {
    oe_ths_pick_prince = yes
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ths_p }
        set_global_variable = oe_ths_a_begun
        set_variable = { name = oe_ths_prince value = scope:oe_ths_p }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ths_a_wait months = 24 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.1
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ths test: no prince for the second court" }
}
# thsb: the second court (if not yet) and the blockade, .2 at once.
oe_ths_test_siege = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ths_prince } }
        oe_ths_pick_prince = yes
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_ths_p } set_variable = { name = oe_ths_prince value = scope:oe_ths_p } }
    }
    set_global_variable = oe_ths_a_begun
    if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_ths_stage_a ?= 1 } } oe_ths_a_court = yes }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.2
}
# thsw: resolve -30.
oe_ths_test_will = { oe_ths_will_add = { n = -30 } }
# thsr: an Ottoman prince seeks refuge (.10).
oe_ths_test_refuge = {
    oe_ths_refuge = yes
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ths_cand } } debug_log = "oe_ths test: no Ottoman prince can seek refuge" }
}
# thsm: bet months +12 (round 2 only).
oe_ths_test_months = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_bet_round ?= 2 has_variable = oe_bet_m } change_variable = { name = oe_bet_m add = 12 } }
}
# thsx: settle the bet now (round 2 only).
oe_ths_test_resolve = {
    if = { limit = { oe_bet_running = yes var:oe_bet_round ?= 2 } oe_bet_resolve = yes }
}
# thsd: the blockade of 1422 (.20) at once.
oe_ths_test_blockade = {
    if = { limit = { location:thessaloniki = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ths.20 }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_ths test: Thessaloniki is not ours" }
}
